subject: SIG intake: OrchardPay initial questionnaire
messages:
From: Maya Rios <security@orchardpay.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG request and timeline

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for taking this. Attached is OrchardPay's SIG request and a short priority list. We're running a vendor review cycle and need initial SIG responses and evidence for high-priority sections (Access Control, Change Management, Logging & Monitoring) within 7 business days if possible.

Can you confirm:
- Who will own each SIG section at Redwood?
- Whether you can provide the evidence files (policies, screenshots, audit logs) or a plan to collect them?
- A single point of contact for follow-ups and a time for a 30-minute triage call this week?

Attached: OrchardPay_SIG_Request_20270303.pdf (SIG matrix + priority list), access_matrix.csv (requested template).

Appreciate a quick confirmation — we have a compliance gating deadline on 2027-03-18.

Thanks,
Maya Rios
Security Operations Manager
OrchardPay Inc.
security@orchardpay.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Maya Rios <security@orchardpay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG request and timeline

Hi Maya —

Thanks for the packet and the deadline flag. I'm Hannah (Security Ops lead for vendor intake) — looping in Karthik (platform security / evidence) and Marissa (compliance SME).

Quick answers:
- We'll triage and propose section owners within 24 hours.
- We'll aim to deliver evidence for the high-priority sections within 7 business days; if something needs longer we'll call it out immediately.
- Proposed POC for Redwood: me (hannah.schmitt@redwood.com).

I'm scheduling a 30-min triage for today at 3:30pm PT. If that doesn't work for you, please suggest a time.

Hannah Schmitt
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Maya Rios <security@orchardpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>

On Wed, Mar 3, 2027 at 9:12 AM Maya Rios <security@orchardpay.com> wrote:
> Hi Hannah —
> 
> Thanks for taking this. Attached is OrchardPay's SIG request and a short priority list. We're running a vendor review cycle and need initial SIG responses and evidence for high-priority sections (Access Control, Change Management, Logging & Monitoring) within 7 business days if possible.

Thanks, Maya — we'll take this on. Drafting owners below (owners + target dates). If anyone sees a conflict, reply-all and we'll reassign.

Proposed section assignments (initial pass):
- Access Control (Section 2): Karthik Iyer — evidence: IAM policy, role matrix, screenshot of RBAC console. Target: 2027-03-10.
- Change Management (Section 4): Marissa Cole — evidence: change policy, change ticket sample, release notes extract. Target: 2027-03-10.
- Logging & Monitoring (Section 8): Soojin Lee — evidence: log retention policy, Splunk/Datadog screenshots, sample alert runbook. Target: 2027-03-10.
- Data Classification & Handling (Section 5): Dylan Brooks — evidence: data classification doc, handling checklist. Target: 2027-03-12.
- Backup & Recovery (Section 7): Hannah Schmitt — evidence: DR runbook excerpt, backup job summary. Target: 2027-03-12.

Action items for owners:
1) Confirm acceptance by EOD.
2) Upload evidence to the shared Drive folder (link below) and use the access_matrix.csv template from the requester.
3) Flag any evidence that requires redaction or legal review (cc legal@redwood.com).

Shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSIGRequest
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.company/contacts/ORCH-9921

I'll own the review pass once materials are collected and produce the first-pass SIG response. Hannah — will coordinate the triage call.

-Karthik
Principal Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Rios <security@orchardpay.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG request and timeline

Thanks — accepting the Change Management section. Attached is an initial bundle: change_policy_v2.pdf (policy), change_ticket_sample.pdf (redacted ticket), and a small CSV mapping release tags to dates.

Notes / blockers:
- We do not retain full change ticket history beyond 18 months in the live system — for older requests we can provide archived exports, but that takes a couple of days.
- Legal asked to review one screenshot that contains a customer email before we share; I'll mark that separately in the Drive.

Attachments: change_policy_v2.pdf (policy), change_ticket_sample.pdf (redacted), release_tag_history.csv

Marissa Cole
Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

> Proposed section assignments (initial pass):
> - Logging & Monitoring (Section 8): Soojin Lee — evidence: log retention policy, Splunk/Datadog screenshots, sample alert runbook. Target: 2027-03-10.

Confirming Logging & Monitoring ownership. I've uploaded the log_retention_policy.pdf and a sanitized alert_runbook.pdf to the Drive. Two quick items:
- Splunk access screenshots will need redaction of customer identifiers; I'll coordinate with Marissa for legal review.
- For retention metrics we store aggregated retention metrics in observability-archive S3 — I can provide the export but it will need the data team to run the job (ETA 48 hours).

Next steps:
- I'll pull the Splunk screenshots and flag any PII for redaction.
- Hannah / Karthik: can we confirm who will send the initial SIG response bundle back to OrchardPay? I can assemble my section's artifacts into the Drive folder.

Soojin Lee
Senior Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
